verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents some versioning and review building blocks. Profiles are declared in version-controlled YAML that generates SQL, transformations can be tested against sample events before deploying, and audit logs are accessible via API and MCP. Nothing shows native version history, change review/approval, or rollback for pipelines or transformations. missing for 10: native version history for transformations/pipelines, review/approval workflow for changes, documented rollback to prior versions, independent or hands-on corroboration.
